info.cls_ename: Master's Program in Statistics and Actuarial Science, Department of Statistics

description.describe_ch: 此課程乃是精算科學的專業課程，將保險公司的收支系統利用數學模型來建構與分析，根據過去的收支危險訊息來釐訂未來的費率和準備金。
description.describe_eh: The course is organized around the principle that much of actuarial science consists of the construction and analysis of mathematical models which describe the process by which funds flow into and out of an insurance system. It is a set of quantitative tools which allows an insurer to perform prospective experience rating and reserving, adjust future premiums based on past experience, on a risk of group of risks.

targets.describe_ch: 應用可信度理論、模型建構及參數估計到保險實務
targets.describe_en: To apply credibility theory, model selection and parameter estimation in an insurance context.

targets.describe_ch: 理解產險經驗費率釐訂和準備金提存相關知識
targets.describe_en: To understand the knowledge of short term insurance experience rating and reserving.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
Academic misconduct refers to practices that a student or a researcher is aware of but deliberately and significantly deviates from the genreally accepted academic behavior, such as fabrication, falsification, plagiarism and any act of dishonesty in any forms. Depending on the research stage, research misconduct can be divided into five types:
1. inappropriate data collection
2. fabrication (falsification) of lab data
3. plagiarism
4. inappropriate authorship or designation
5. duplicate submission, publication, and application
Reference Link: https://ethics.moe.edu.tw/resource/englishguide/redirect/?pid=1&ft=odp
 
Penalties for academic misconduct can range from a grade of zero of the assignment(s)/assessment(s) to a penalty as severe as suspension for multiple dishonest acts reported.
